name: Utah Big Blind-off 2018

venue.name: Thanksgiving Point Museum of Ancient Life
venue.details: It's in the Amber Room, which is on the second floor.  Stairs are to the right of the entrance.

information: The registration fee is $18. There is a competitor limit of 100 competitors. If you want to be on the competitor list you must complete registration (which includes payment) as soon as possible. There will be no on-site registration allowed. Spectators are free!
